bookmarks.command: function pkill { param([Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][string]$Name); $processes = Get-Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -like "*$Name*" }; if ($processes) { $processes | ForEach-Object { try { Stop-Process -Id $_.Id -Force -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Host "Killed: $($_.Name) (PID: $($_.Id))" -ForegroundColor Green } catch { Write-Host "Failed to kill: $($_.Name) (PID: $($_.Id)) - $_" -ForegroundColor Red } } } else { Write-Host "No process found matching '$Name'" -ForegroundColor Yellow } }; pkill -Name "[[App Name]]"

ai_system_prompts.name: Study Note
ai_system_prompts.text:
make a study note for this
md syntex formet is a bit different here is how i use them

#1.5#text#/#  = extra big text
##text##  = big text
**text** = bold text, also dont ever use single star syntax i saw u sometime use them which are not defined in my project so they shows single star which is annoying and i have to fix them to double star
@@text@@ = italic text
__text__ = underline
- text = list 1
-- text = list 2
--- text = list 3
Dont add unnecessary extra lines between heading and its content
dont use --- or dash to add separator just keep single empty line for spacing
try to use table for organizing similar types things
mostly use bengla language other than some names or important things
No advertisement or any other talk like about coaching etc only study note
For math use katex or latex formatting with \(Math\) or $Math$ and also dont use math signs for any number or math related text. just only use for any eqation or signs that need it
For math follow this kind of structure for question examples:-
| সমস্যা নং | বিষয়বস্তু | ইকুয়েশন (Equation) ও সমাধান |
| --- | --- | --- |
Also based on the lecture keep the sequene of rules properly and also dont skip any examples
Also at the end add a small suggestion/quick table so i can fast review the study note

any shortcut for all the methods so we can easily calculate them without any x
